messages:
emma (finance): Solaris AI still owes INV-2026-1207 for $31,250 (due 2026-03-05). No remittance in our ledger. Can AE/AP confirm status so we don’t trigger the hold?

raj (acct-exec): Pinged Tom at AP earlier. They reported a payment hold in their system because our invoice lacked the project code (PX-77). I sent an amended invoice with PX-77 included 30m ago.

tom (Solaris AI AP): Confirmed we received updated invoice. Finance queued ACH but treasury window is tomorrow morning. We can do a split: 40% today, remainder on 2026-03-09. Will that stop the hold?

emma (finance): We can accept a split as short-term. Need at least 40% ($12,500) posted by 2026-03-07 09:00 UTC with bank confirmation (screenshot or remittance file). Mask full account numbers. If full balance clears by 2026-03-09 EOD we'll waive the standard $200 reinstatement fee.

raj (acct-exec): Offering the waiver in writing now. Tom, please confirm acceptance so I can send the waiver email.

tom (Solaris AI AP): Solaris accepts the $200 waiver conditional on the split payment schedule. I'll upload remittance proof when treasury processes the ACH.
maria (legal): Note: per contract late fee applies after 30 days. Collections escalation (demand letter) starts if promised payments are missed and no funds within 7 days of missed PTP. Document the PTP in the account notes.

ops (infra): Heads-up: if billing hold happens we will throttle API throughput for the enterprise tier. It'll start with background jobs; customer-facing keys may remain active for 24h. I can prepare a mitigation runbook.

collections-bot: Notice: Billing hold for "solaris-ai" scheduled 2026-03-07 09:00 UTC if outstanding balance > $0. Use `/payments check INV-2026-1207` to refresh.

emma (finance): Thanks. @raj paste masked remittance here when available and I'll clear the pending hold and file the waiver note. If we don't see payment by the morning cutoff we'll issue the suspension notice. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
